title: VERDICT platform evaluation (Framework v0.3.1)
description: Front matter schema for a single VERDICT platform evaluation file. Mirrors ENGINE.md v0.3.1-final.

independence.description: independent = standalone; parent = operator is itself the parent company; subsidiary = owned by a parent entity; unrecorded = ownership/control structure was NOT assessed/recorded in the original published evaluation (MIGRATION-ONLY honest value; co-occurs with the migrated-capture tag). New Layer 0 evaluations MUST assess independence and MUST NOT use 'unrecorded'.

parent_entity.description: Required (non-null) when independence = subsidiary; null otherwise.

category.description: Free-text VERDICT category. Must be consistent across platforms (e.g. 'AI Coding Agent', 'Browser Agent', 'Enterprise Agent', 'Workflow Automation').

updated_at.description: Most-recent re-evaluation date (Layer C update or differential 'Update' evaluation), distinct from 'evaluated_at' (original Layer 0 date). Captured from the re-evaluation event; SSOT is this value. Pipeline MUST NOT derive it from file commit metadata — a non-evaluative edit (e.g., sources / card_tags backfill) is not a re-evaluation and must not surface an 'Updated' date. Optional; absent when no re-evaluation has occurred. Pairs with evaluation_type='update'. In the fresh-evaluation flow this pairs with evaluation_type='update'; migrated captures MAY carry updated_at with evaluation_type='initial' when the published card shows an Updated date but the record publishes no differential content (date published, revision content unpublished — captured as-is).

score_basis.description: consistent = published total equals published dimension sum (default; validate enforces sum-check). published_inconsistent = the published sources for this evaluation disagree such that the captured total does not equal the captured dimension sum (e.g., live-card dims vs evaluation-record dims); both captured as-published, divergence disclosed in body, NOT reconciled in migration; resolution = re-evaluation. validate skips the sum-check ONLY for this value.

cve_count_12mo.description: Exact published trailing-12mo CVE count. null ONLY when the original evaluation published no exact integer (see cve_count_basis). For migrated evals; new evals MUST publish an exact integer with basis 'exact'.

cve_count_basis.description: Provenance of cve_count_12mo. exact = published exact integer (count = that integer). lower_bound = eval published 'N+' (count = N, the published floor; NOT asserted exact). range = eval published 'A-B' (count = A, the published lower end). unrecorded = no published count anywhere (count = null; may be qualitatively non-zero — see body). conflicting = published sources disagree (count = null; divergence recorded in body, NOT silently reconciled). Co-occurs with migrated-capture tag.

known_facts_applied.description: Entity keys from KNOWN_FACTS.md that were applied during evaluation. Empty array if none applicable.

sources.description: Public-data source URLs the evaluation relies on; structured index of body Evidence citations. Optional. Percent-encoded URIs (e.g. %20) are valid per RFC 3986.

finding.description: HTML .finding block: one-paragraph human-authored compression of the evaluation, sourced from evaluations/{NNN}.md. Pipeline carries verbatim; pipeline must not generate or alter.

meta_owner.description: HTML meta-owner line: operator/funding one-liner, human-authored from evaluations Contextual Analysis. Pipeline carries verbatim.

meta_description.description: HTML meta description / og:description: human-authored SEO summary. Pipeline carries verbatim.

og_description.description: HTML og:description: human-authored short social summary, distinct from meta_description. Pipeline carries verbatim.

category_line.description: HTML category meta line (full): human-authored, e.g. 'Vector Database · Retrieval Infrastructure · ...'. Distinct from structured 'category'. Pipeline carries verbatim.

display_tags.description: HTML colored tag chips: human-authored text + risk color. Pipeline renders verbatim.

key_finding.description: Top-index card body summary: long-form human-authored card text, distinct from the shorter per-platform 'finding'. Authored content under the two-regime SSOT rule: SSOT is this verbatim text (captured from live card or authored by Engine from the evaluation). Pipeline carries verbatim; pipeline must not generate, recompute, or alter.

card_owner.description: Top-index card owner display text: card-specific intermediate summary (e.g. 'Pinecone Systems, Inc. · New York · a16z Series B'), distinct from structured 'operator' and from 'meta_owner'. Authored content; SSOT is this verbatim text. Pipeline carries verbatim; must not generate or alter.

card_category.description: Top-index card category display text: short-form card variant, distinct from structured 'category' and from the longer 'category_line'. Authored content; SSOT is this verbatim text. Pipeline carries verbatim; must not generate or alter.

card_tags.description: Top-index card tag strip: card-specific authored tag set, distinct from the page-regime 'display_tags' (independently edited: text, count, color, and order may diverge). Authored content under the two-regime SSOT rule: SSOT is this verbatim array (captured from live card or authored by Engine from the evaluation). Pipeline carries verbatim; must not generate, recompute, or alter. HTML wrapper markup is renderer-derived and is NOT part of this field.
